channel.title: Crypto Structure Brief
channel.description: Independent crypto news tracking capital flows, exchange liquidity, derivatives positioning and protocol activity for researchers and market analysts.

item.title: SyncSwap Keeps ZKsync at the Center of Its Liquidity
item.description: SyncSwap still concentrates liquidity on ZKsync Era, but modest turnover and incomplete Aqua-pool coverage complicate the case for durable market depth.

item.title: Transaction Batching Turns Shared Bytes Into Lower Fees
item.description: Transaction batching cuts fees by sharing fixed transaction data across many payments, but operators trade speed, privacy and fee-bumping flexibility.

item.title: Block Propagation Sets Crypto’s Real Speed Limit
item.description: Propagation turns bandwidth and validation time into missed slots, reorg risk and higher data costs, making network design—not block time—the real speed limit.

item.title: SGX Opens Bitcoin and Ether Perpetuals to U.S. Institutions
item.description: CFTC authorization connects eligible U.S. firms to SGX’s existing crypto order book, but onboarding—not permission—will decide whether liquidity deepens.
